description: Register of TWS API connection IDs used by trading tools. Each tool uses a unique ID so they can run in parallel without interfering.

1001.description: Reads portfolio-level option Greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega) and bucketed Greeks from TWS

1002.description: Reads account margin usage: NLV and excess liquidity from TWS

1004.description: Places a new order in TWS with a risk pre-check gate

1005.description: Cancels an existing open order in TWS

1006.description: Emergency de-risking: closes all positions in a given scope (symbol, strategy, or account)

1007.description: Monitors stop and target orders for open positions; flags missing or stale stops

1008.description: Detects current and projected portfolio risk limit breaches (delta, vega, concentration, margin)

1009.description: Pre-trade quote, session state, and liquidity snapshot from TWS

1010.description: Modifies existing open orders via native modify or cancel/replace

1011.description: Polls lifecycle status, fill details, commissions, and event log for a specific order

1018.description: PTJ Crash Playbook / Liquidity Breakdown detector: reads daily bars and evaluates crash/liquidity-stress setup state for LLM consumption
